Minutes of the 44th sEC Meeting held on llth January, 2022 in the Conference Hall of Chief
Secretary, Assam, Janata Bhawan, Dispur.
List of members present is enclosed as Annexure I
The Chief Secretary cum Chairperson, SEC chaired the meeting. He welcomed the members present and
asked the Chief Executive Officer, Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA) to present the
agenda of the meeting for discussion.
Agenda ltem: l. Confirmation of minutes of the 43'd SEC Meeting.
Resolution: The State Executive Committee confirmed the minutes of its 43'd meeting held on 13th
February,202L.
Agenda ltem 2: Action taken report on the minutes of the 43rd Meeting of SEC
Resolution: The State Executive Committee noted the Action Taken Report on decisions taken during
the 43'd SEC meeting and directed as following:
1.
Proposals approved for PHE Department regarding procurement of water treatment vans in
43'd sEc meeting to be dropped as the department has informed that the projects could not
take off due to sufficient availability of vans.
2'
The Fire and Emergency services, Assam to complete the bidding process for procurement of
1517 Fire proximity suits within March 2022.
Atenda ltem 3: Approval of Annual Work plan and budget for 20Zl-22 and 2022-2023
Resolution: sEC approved item wise allocation of resources under Non salary Head amounting to
Rs.579.00 lakhs received from the State budget during 2020-21 and noted the pace of expenditure as
detailed in Annexure-ll.
SEC considered the work plan of 2022-23 and approved item wise allocation of resources amounting to
Rs.1560.00 lakhs budgeted in the current year (2o2r-221 which would be spent du'ing zoz2-23
(Annexure-lll).
Further, sEc considered the detailed work plan prepared based on expected receipts and projected
expenditure amounting to Rs. 57 ,75,99,75t/- to be executed during 2022-23 (AnnexuretV).

(SEC) Meeting held on February 3, 2025 in the

List of members present is enclosed as Annexure I
At the outset of the meeting, the Chairperson of the State Executive
Committee (SEC) welcomed the members present. After deliberation on
the agenda the following resolutions were made.
52.1: Confirmation of minutes of the 51st Meeting of SEC
Resolution: The State Executive Committee confirmed the minutes of
its 51st meeting held on October 1, 2024.
51.2: Action Taken Report on the decisions of 51st SEC meeting
Resolution: The State Executive Committee took note of the Action
Taken Report placed before the committee and gave the following
directions:
1. Assam Public Works Roads Department (APWRD), Water Resources
Department and Irrigation Department to apprise the Chairperson SEC
regarding progress of SEC approved projects under SDRF which are yet to
be completed in e-file within two days.
2. The issues related to date of initiation and completion of three SDRF
proposals amounting to Rs. 553.35 lakhs executed by WRD in Majuli to be
apprised in file by ASDMA after taking the exact details from the Water
Resources Department.
3. Module one of the proposal of IIT Guwahati for Capacity Building amounting
to Rs 6,33,50,000/- to be implemented for training program using existing
facilities within the campus of IITG covering the cost of food & lodging in
IITG, local transportation within IITG , course material, use of computational
facility, laboratory, and field visit etc. for the participants.
Meanwhile, ASDMA may explore funds under NDMF for
implementation of Module two of the proposal i.e. Construction of
ICDRR amounting to Rs 15,83,44,095/-.
52. 3: DPR for wetland projects “Restoration and Rejuvenation
of wetlands of Assam to enhance water retention capacity and
mitigate risk of flooding and erosion”
Resolution: The State Executive Committee approved the DPR for
Restoration and Rejuvenation of 16 wetlands of Assam amounting to Rs.
634.83 to enhance water retention capacity and mitigate risk of flooding
--- Page 2 ---
ASDMA-29/28/2022-DRR - ASDMA-Assam State Disaster Management I/927731/2025
and erosion for submission to the Government of India by the Water
Resources Department for funding under National Mitigation Fund.
List of the projects are at Annexure-II
SEC also gave the following directions to the Water Resources
Department, Assam :
1. As per the Guidelines for project under NDMF/SDMF issued by the NDMA
vide No 5-20/2014- Mit/8082 (E-111264) dated 06th March 2023, large scale
mitigation interventions such as construction of coastal walls, flood
embankments etc. are not to be taken from the mitigation fund (c lause 2
of MHA, Guidelines No.33-02/2020-NDM-I dated 28th February 2022),
as such instead of the embankments “water retention and sediment
control bunds” may be proposed in the DPR.
2. As per the clause 12 of the same guideline, there is a lower limit of Rs.10
Crore for a mitigation project to be financed from NDMF for structural
measures, so a justification and rationale to be incorporated for inclusion of
the project viz. ‘’Flood mitigation by capacity augmentation of Mansiri
wetland area for flood regulation amounting to Rs. 5.69 crores” in the
DPR.
3. As per para 12 (i) of the guidelines at least 10 % of the project component
should be for non-structural measures. So, necessary non-structural
components may be suitably included in the overall DPR keeping overall cost
within 714 crores projected earlier in the concept note.
The Chairperson, SEC further directed WRD to incorporate location
specific photographs in all future presentations to be made in connection
with this project.

recommendation of the Fifteen Finance Commission

Honorarium Policy for Expert Committee Members
invited by ASDMA for Recruitment/Bid
Evaluation/conduct of training etc.
Introduction:
This policy outlines in principles for awarding honorariums to the
individuals other than officials serving at ASDMA and Revenue & Disaster
Management Deptt., who participate as Selection Committee/Bid
Committee/Expert Committee/Resource members for conducting official
Recruitment/Bid Evaluation/Expert Review / conduct of training etc. at
Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA).
In terms of the provision FR 46 (Note: (b)) of F.R & S.R. subject to the
approval of the State Government, Assam State Disaster Management
Authority has decided to offer the honorarium in monetary term to the
Government servant or any official other than employee of ASDMA and
Revenue & Disaster Management Dept. against the work performed by
the respective official as member of the committee which is considered
to be intermittent or occasional in character and either so laborious or of
such special merit as to justify.
Objective:
To recognize the valuable time, expertise, and effort contributed by
various Committee/Panel members.
To attract and retain qualified individuals to serve on ASDMA
selection/Expert panels.
To ensure fair and transparent compensation practices.
Eligibility:
Individuals invited by ASDMA to serve on Recruitment
Committee/Bid Evaluation Committee/Expert Committee duly
constituted by ASDMA and a fixed panel of Officials/Non-Official
Members so created who would participate either in person or
virtually in the process. To include any other new members in the
list based on requirement prior approval of Chief Secretary, Govt. of
Assam needs to be taken for creation of Committee.
Individuals/Officials serving in ASDMA and Revenue & Disaster
Management Dept shall not be eligible to receive the honorarium.
Payment Modality:
Upon completion of the assigned Committee duties, the member
will receive a form for submitting bank account details and
confirming their participation.
The payment will be clearly marked as an "Honorarium for ASDMA
participation with regards to Recruitment/Bid Evaluation/Expert
Committee" for transparency purposes.
The amount payable per Committee Member will be ₹1500/- per
sitting of respective Committee Meeting. Also, for member of Bid
--- Page 13 ---
ASDMA-29/28/2022-DRR - ASDMA-Assam State Disaster Management I/927731/2025
Evaluation Committee payment shall be made for maximum 03
(three) engagements of the respective Bid Evaluation Cycle.
For Recruitment/Expert Committee Members engaged for aforesaid
works at ASDMA and travelling from different city, local
accommodation, food charges and local conveyance charges to the
office will be paid subject to submission of appropriate bills and
signing of documents.
The expenditure will be debited to the Office Expenditure Fund
under Non Salary Component of ASDMA (2245-80-800-4259-000-32-
99) or to the Scheme/Sub-scheme to which the activities closely
associate with subject to availability of fund.
Additional Considerations:
Travel expenses incurred by the Committee Members attending
outside their city will be reimbursed based either on distance
travelled in Kilometres as per details submitted in T E Form of
ASDMA office or respective Bill submitted in case of the vehicle is
hired from their end whichever applicable. However, this will not be
applicable to Committee members availing Govt. Transport.
Travel allowance of Rs. 500/- will be paid to Committee members
attending within the same city who is not availing the Govt.
Transport.
In case of vehicle hired by ASDMA for the cause, the payments for
the travelling expenses of the Committee Member/s will be made by
ASDMA Office to the respective Hiring Agency.
In case of unforeseen circumstances leading to cancellation of the
evaluation/review process by ASDMA, the member will still be
eligible for honorarium to acknowledge their preparedness and time
commitment. In case information regarding cancellation of the
process is conveyed to the concerned member well ahead in time
no honorarium will be paid for the same.
This policy may evolve based on periodic reviews and feedback
from stakeholders and as decided by the Authority.
Chief Executive Officer,

Minutes of the 55th State Executive Committee (SEC) meeting
held on January 28, 2026 in the Conference Hall of the Chief
Secretary, Assam, Lok Sewa Bhawan, Dispur.
List of members present is enclosed as Annexure I
At the outset of the meeting, the Chairperson of the State Executive
Committee (SEC) welcomed the members present.
The Additional Chief Secretary to the Government of Assam, Revenue &
Disaster Management Department & Chief Executive Officer, ASDMA
presented the agenda before the Committee for discussion and
necessary direction.
After deliberation on the agenda the following resolutions were made.
55.1: Confirmation of minutes of the 54th Meeting of SEC
Resolution: The State Executive Committee confirmed the minutes of
its 54th meeting held on October 9, 2025.
55.2: Action Taken Report on the decisions of 54th SEC meeting
Resolution: The State Executive Committee took note of the Action
Taken Report and gave the following directions:
1. Fire & Emergency Services, Assam to complete the procurement of
items for which work orders have already been issued by them
within March 2026 as the fund allotted under XV FC for the purpose
will lapse beyond this time line.
2. Fire & Emergency Services to complete the price negotiation with
the successful bidder within a week for the procurement of
remaining items against which tenders were floated under XV FC
allocation.
3. ASDMA to develop a mechanism for regularly monitoring physical
and financial progress of projects approved under SDRF, SDMF,
NDRF and NDMF by SEC.
4. ASDMA to hold regular coordination meeting with GSI, DoHUA,
National Institute of Hydrology (NIH), DDMA Barpeta, CWC, NESAC
etc. for ensuring timely completion of the study on Integrated geo-
environmental appraisal of Barpeta town, Howli town, Barpeta Road
and its adjoining area to assess the causes and remedies of urban
flood.
5. Irrigation, PWD Roads, Power, School Education Department to
submit status of physical and financial progress report and action
plan for implementation of projects approved by SEC in its 54th
meeting held on October 9, 2025 to ASDMA within a week.
